segments.title: 第105章 我在等你
segments.content:
Reigniting the Verdant Years Chapter 105: I'm Waiting for You

In mid-October, the midterm exams at Fuzhong No. 1 High School arrived as scheduled.

Li Luo directed his classmates, arranging the classroom's desks and chairs into six separate columns, setting it up as an exam hall for the midterms.

During the placement exam at the start of the semester, Li Luo had ranked 328th in the school and, according to his ranking, was assigned to Class 9's classroom for the exam.

Meanwhile, students like Lu Jiahao from his class, whose ranking broke into the school's top hundred, were able to take their exams in Class 2's classroom based on their placement.

Any student from a regular class who could enter an advanced class's classroom for an exam was considered a god-slayer in the eyes of ordinary students.

And those advanced class students who were pushed out of their own classrooms by students from regular classes belonged to the more disgraceful category.

After all, they had already completed the entire first-year high school curriculum in the summer prep classes, yet they couldn't even outperform others on an exam covering junior high content. It was truly a bit indefensible.

There were many reasons for this, among them students who became complacent and stagnated after getting in through independent admissions.

Once their rankings fell out of the advanced class range, while still studying in the high-pressure environment surrounded by top students from the advanced class, their grades could plummet, making it difficult to ever rise again.

Conversely, some students, despite being in a regular class, developed their confidence by consistently being at the top of their class. They could often break into the school's top hundred, having an even better time than those in the advanced classes.

As the saying goes, it's better to be the head of a chicken than the tail of a phoenix. Sometimes, that's just how it is.

Because there were nine subjects in the first year of high school, the exams ran from Wednesday to Friday, with one core subject and two minor subjects each day.

Most people weren't particularly nervous. After all, it was just the midterms, and the scores and rankings didn't mean much.

But there were people like Shao Heqi, who was fired up this time, vowing to surpass Li Luo in the overall score.

Especially in Shao Heqi's view, this guy Li Luo had joined the basketball club, then the literature club, and a few days ago, some rock music club since the semester began.

None of them were academic competition clubs.

This was a clear sign that he had no intention of studying seriously.

Shao Heqi, on the other hand, had chosen the physics club and would go for in-depth study there every evening and on Saturday afternoons.

Combined with his diligent studying and exam preparation since the start of the semester, Shao Heqi was determined to make a stunning impression in the midterms.

His strengths were in the sciences, and for the humanities subjects like history, geography, and politics, as long as he memorized the textbooks well, there wouldn't be a significant score gap.

With this, he had full confidence that he would vanquish Li Luo!

At this moment, Li Luo was completely unaware of Shao Heqi's ambition.

He was just using the last bit of review time during the morning self-study session, closing his eyes in a semblance of rest, but was actually filling in the gaps in his memory palace, confirming that all the knowledge points needed for the exams were ready.

Whether it was knowledge points from the textbooks, the teacher's notes on the blackboard during class, or the various viewpoints and conclusions provided on the PowerPoints, he had recorded them all one by one.

They were all categorized and processed according to each subject.

With just a slight turn of his thoughts during the exam, the information he needed would automatically appear in his mind.

When the preparatory bell for the exam rang, the three academic buildings of Fuzhong No. 1 High School instantly erupted in a clamor.

Everyone packed up their exam materials, walked out of their classrooms, and headed to their assigned exam halls.

Before leaving, Li Luo extended a fist toward Yan Zhusheng in the back seat, "Good luck on the exam."

"Good luck." Yan Zhusheng extended her fist and gently bumped his.

Her score on the placement exam was slightly better than Li Luo's, so her exam hall was conveniently in Class 8, right at her own desk. She didn't have to move at all, which was very convenient.

Li Luo, on the other hand, grabbed his pencil case and went to Class 9's classroom downstairs.

For three consecutive days.

Fuzhong No. 1 High School was immersed in an exceptionally serious atmosphere.

All club activities came to a complete halt.

Other than one exam in the morning and two in the afternoon each day, all remaining time was converted into self-study periods.

Teachers of various subjects took turns supervising in the classrooms, available at the lectern to answer and handle students' questions.

When the final politics exam finished on Friday, everyone breathed a sigh of relief. The string that had been pulled taut all this time finally went completely slack.

"There's no self-study session this Saturday." After the exam, Kong Junxiang came into the classroom and reminded the students, "School ends at five in the evening. Be safe on your way home."

"Woohoo!" Although they already knew, Zhu Yufei and Zhang Guohuang in the back row still cheered, finally able to leave school on a Friday.

The other boys followed suit, and the classroom was filled with joyous clamor.

But in the next second, Kong Junxiang smilingly pulled out a stack of notices and handed them to Hua Xiuxiu in the front row, "Pass these out for everyone."

"This is the notice for the parent-teacher conference. Remember to show it to your mom and dad when you get home today."

"The parent-teacher conference is scheduled for next Saturday morning. If both your parents are busy and can't make it, they must personally call me to explain the situation."

"Oh, right. Although the exams should be graded by this weekend, the specific scores will probably be announced on the day of the parent-teacher conference."

At this point, Kong Junxiang's smile widened a bit, "I hope you can all make your parents proud."

As soon as he said this, a chorus of groans filled the air.

Even though everyone had been top students in their junior high schools before coming to Fuzhong No. 1 High School.

After arriving here, most of them felt like they had become just another face in the crowd.

At their previous parent-teacher conferences in junior high, their parents had all been able to hold their heads high in the classroom.

They didn't know if their own dads and moms would be able to accept this drop-off after coming to Fuzhong No. 1 High School.

But Li Luo was thinking about another problem.

"Will your mom be coming?" Li Luo whispered to Yan Zhusheng.

Taking the parent-teacher conference notice from the student in front of her, Yan Zhusheng pursed her lips, "My mom... her new album is being released soon, so she probably has a lot of promotional events to attend."

"It's just one morning, it should be fine, right?" Li Luo said with a frown.

Yan Zhusheng shook her head, "It's alright. Her comeback after so many years is already very difficult. This is just a parent-teacher conference on my end, it's not that important."

"You should still ask first," Li Luo said. "Maybe she'll happen to be free that day."

"Okay." Yan Zhusheng nodded, then turned to look at Li Luo and asked curiously, "For you, will your uncle or auntie be coming?"

"Well," Li Luo said, rubbing his chin, "based on past experience, whenever my grades are good, my mom comes. If my grades are bad, or if I get into trouble at school, my dad comes."

"So... your mom will be coming this time?" Yan Zhusheng guessed.

"Seems like you have a lot of confidence in me," Li Luo said with a grin. "How do you know I'll do well this time?"

"Because Xixi and Senior Sister have been tutoring you," Yan Zhusheng said honestly. "You're bound to have made some improvement."

"It's not just some improvement. I think I can get into the top 40 this time," Li Luo raised his eyebrows. "Wanna bet?"

"Okay," Yan Zhusheng nodded. "I bet you can get into the top 40. If I win, what's the reward?"

Li Luo: "?"

"Aren't you getting it backward?"

"No," Yan Zhusheng said, shaking her head. "I believe in you."

Li Luo looked speechless. "...You really don't have to believe in me that much. It gives me no sense of accomplishment."

The two chatted for a while. Kong Junxiang on the lectern glanced at the time and told everyone to pack their things and get ready to leave.

Before leaving, Kong Junxiang said at the classroom door, "Li Luo, Hua Xiuxiu, you two come to my office for a moment."

The class president and vice president, whose names had been called, stood up from their seats and followed Kong Junxiang all the way to the office on the fifth floor.

Before entering the office, Li Luo happened to run into Ying Chanxi, who was coming up the stairs from the other side.

Ying Chanxi was following Teacher Sun, and it looked like she also had something to be instructed about.

"Li Luo!" In front of many students and teachers in the hallway, Ying Chanxi called out to Li Luo, "Your mom said to come home for dinner today. My dad is back too."

While others were still brainstorming, trying to figure out the relationship between the two, Li Luo had already given Ying Chanxi an "OK" gesture and followed Kong Junxiang into the office.

"Next Saturday is the parent-teacher conference. I'll need two assistants at that time to help pour tea for the parents, hand out materials, and so on."

Kong Junxiang said, "And since the students will also be here on Saturday morning, we need to arrange things for them."

"The school's plan is to open up club activities on Saturday morning."

"After the parent-teacher conference in the classroom is over, we will also arrange for the first-year parents to tour the clubs."

"At that time, you two will be responsible for leading the groups, guiding the parents and introducing our school's clubs and their special features."

"Here is all the introductory material for the school's clubs. Get familiar with it this week."

With that, Kong Junxiang handed two files to Li Luo and Hua Xiuxiu.

Li Luo glanced through them; they were mostly very official-sounding descriptions.

When he saw the rock music club on the list, he couldn't help but raise his eyebrows. "There are also performances scheduled?"

"Oh, you mean the rock music club?" Kong Junxiang smiled. "There will be a performance for the first-year parents at the stadium. I remember you're in it, right? It's a good chance to practice before the sports meet."

Hearing Teacher Kong say this, the thought of performing in front of his parents made Li Luo, who had always been calm and composed since his rebirth, feel a rare sense of nervousness.

"Alright, that's all from me. You two can go back, pack up, and head home."

After coming out of Teacher Kong's office, Li Luo saw Ying Chanxi waiting by the stairwell.

"I'm going back to the classroom to get my bag. Wait for me in your classroom."

"Got it."

Li Luo returned to the Class 8 classroom, planning to pack his bag and leave, only to find Yan Zhusheng still sitting at her desk when he entered.

"Why haven't you gone home yet?"

"I was waiting for you," Yan Zhusheng said, a hint of anticipation in her eyes. "I just told the cooking auntie that I won't be eating at home today."

"Uh..." Hearing her say this, Li Luo scratched his head in embarrassment. "I have to go home with Xixi today. My parents cooked and are waiting for me, so I won't be having dinner here."

Before he finished speaking, Yan Zhusheng had already pursed her lips and lowered her head slightly, "Oh... I see."

After a few seconds, she looked up again. "It's okay. I'll head home then."

Li Luo opened his mouth but didn't ask her to stay.

After all, Ying Zhicheng was back today, so it was a dinner between the two families. It wouldn't be quite appropriate to invite Yan Zhusheng over.

So the two said their goodbyes at the back door of the classroom. Yan Zhusheng waved to him, then shouldered her bag and went downstairs to leave.

A short while later, Ying Chanxi also came downstairs with her bag. After finding Li Luo, the two walked toward the school gate together.

"How did you do on the exams this time?" Ying Chanxi asked curiously.

"I feel pretty good," Li Luo said, stroking his chin in thought, then glanced at Ying Chanxi. "I might even surpass you."

"Oh?" Ying Chanxi looked at him with a half-smile, wearing the expression of the undisputed top student in the grade. "If you can really surpass me, I'll unconditionally grant you one request."

"For real?"

"Of course, it's real."

"Then can I make you bark like a puppy in front of everyone during your speech at the flag-raising ceremony?"

"What kind of stuff is that!?"

"Ow! Why are you hitting me?"

"Don't run! I'll teach you to talk nonsense!"

"You're the one who said any request was fine!"

One chasing and one fleeing, the two quickly ran from the academic building all the way to the school gate.

Just as they were turning the corner to head for the intersection, the horn of a car by the roadside honked.

Ying Zhicheng rolled down the car window and coughed twice as he watched his daughter chasing after Li Luo to hit him.

Li Luo was the first to react. He immediately turned around, pointed at Ying Chanxi, and tattled loudly, "Uncle Ying! Ying Chanxi is bullying me!"

When Ying Chanxi saw her dad, and then saw Li Luo's infuriating look, her face instantly flushed red with anger, "I am not!"

Ying Zhicheng shook his head with a helpless laugh and waved at them. "How old are you two? Aren't you embarrassed? Get in the car."

At a corner of the intersection not far away.

Xu Youyu patted Yan Zhusheng's shoulder and looked strangely toward the back of the car that was already driving away, "What are you looking at?"

"Nothing," Yan Zhusheng shook her head.

"Then let's go." Xu Youyu took her hand and said with a grin, "A classmate recommended a really delicious restaurant. Come have a big meal with me."

(End of Chapter)
